titulo_fr: Confronter plusieurs sources : Repérer les informations
intro: It synthetizes coincidences and differences between three documents with different reach. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It synthetizes coincidences and differences between three documents with different reach. It distinguishes statements, evidence and reservations; it attributes each data to its source before making a conclusion.
Point of attention: Check authorship, date, population and method before comparing figures or inferring a trend. In this fragment, «sondage» means «sondeo».

frases.fr: La note municipale fait état d'une hausse de 18 % des trajets à vélo entre avril et juin.
frases.es: La nota municipal informa de un aumento del 18 % de los trayectos en bicicleta entre abril y junio.
frases.en: The municipal note reports an 18% increase in bike trips between April and June.

frases.fr: Un sondage national, publié la même semaine, indique une progression de 11 % sur l'année entière.
frases.es: Un sondeo nacional, publicado esa misma semana, señala una subida del 11 % durante todo el año.
frases.en: A national survey, published that same week, points to an 11% increase throughout the year.
